admin_policy_lifecycle_check.name: admin_policy_lifecycle_check
admin_policy_lifecycle_check.value:
(
    ("admin_permission_policy_versions"."status" = 'DRAFT' and "admin_permission_policy_versions"."published_at" is null and "admin_permission_policy_versions"."retired_at" is null)
    or ("admin_permission_policy_versions"."status" = 'ACTIVE' and "admin_permission_policy_versions"."published_at" is not null and "admin_permission_policy_versions"."retired_at" is null and "admin_permission_policy_versions"."published_by_principal_id" is not null)
    or ("admin_permission_policy_versions"."status" = 'RETIRED' and "admin_permission_policy_versions"."published_at" is not null and "admin_permission_policy_versions"."retired_at" is not null and "admin_permission_policy_versions"."published_by_principal_id" is not null)
  )

admin_role_scopes_shape_check.name: admin_role_scopes_shape_check
admin_role_scopes_shape_check.value:
(
    ("admin_role_scopes"."scope_kind" = 'PLATFORM' and "admin_role_scopes"."workspace_id" is null and "admin_role_scopes"."resource_kind" is null and "admin_role_scopes"."resource_id" is null)
    or ("admin_role_scopes"."scope_kind" = 'WORKSPACE' and "admin_role_scopes"."workspace_id" is not null and "admin_role_scopes"."resource_kind" is null and "admin_role_scopes"."resource_id" is null)
    or ("admin_role_scopes"."scope_kind" = 'OBJECT' and "admin_role_scopes"."workspace_id" is not null and "admin_role_scopes"."resource_kind" is not null and "admin_role_scopes"."resource_id" is not null)
  )
